Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: optimal control | ID: 30159

Lemma

Step 3. Consider the negative operator \(V_{01290013}\) acting on the symmetric space. By the negative decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|V_{01290013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290013\).

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the rational convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01290011 \cdot C_01290012 \cdot C_01290013\).
